Excellent!!! A Must Dine-In Restaurant
Jun 2020 • Family
Excellent!!! A must dine in experience- the go to spot for everyone’s tastes! The best menus items are; The calamari, any of their salads (which they have many options), the ribeye steaks are always cooked to perfection, the pasta dishes are perfectly flavored and generous portions with all menu items, the pizzas are perfect as well!! The main salmon dish I was a bit disappointed with, so I wouldn’t recommend that dish but everything else on their menu is worth the price and delicious! We all tend to go here often due to the amazing quality and variety of the menu. There are many locations throughout the city and in the malls! So be sure to try Al Frescos anywhere- they are abide by the same standards and I have never been disappointed with any of their restaurants! Truly a great dining experience!!

Dinner after an exhausting day
Oct 2018 • Solo
I had just finished the 3rd of 4 days of presenting a training course, so I crashed out in my hotel room. I was exhausted 😩 
I woke up around 7pm and was really hungry. I hadn’t had a lot of meat on this trip, and remembered that I had an Al Fresco’s voucher in my bag (won at a business chamber event held there a couple of months before). So no brainer, I walked about 1500 metres from my hotel (good for the appetite), up the Al Frescos stairs, and took my place on the balcony.
Loc, the conscientious waitress was immediately on my case, and took my order. Firstly, a pint of draft Tiger, then my food order. 250 grams of medium rare Kiwi fillet steak, veges, mash, and pepper sauce. The food arrived towards the end of the first Tiger, so I ordered another.
Simple to say that the steak was great, the vegetables were very edible, and the sauce was great for the course.
After I finished (it took an hour or so) another group of business people joined the terrace, and I was able to share a bit of banter, and of course another beer.
I won’t tell you how much the voucher was worth, but I walked out with a cash cost of <VND400K.
Up to the usual standard of Big Al (aka Jacko), and Em Loc was superb.
Don’t be put off with AFG being a local food group; they always maintain their high standards.
